chunks: With this chain of transmission, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, from Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl, from Manṣūr ibn Buzurj, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿAmr, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about what is permitted for the husband of a menstruating woman from her. He said: “Everything except the front private part itself.”

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ: a woman in the state of menstruation
key_terms.كُلُّ شَيْءٍ: everything; all other forms are allowed
key_terms.لِصَاحِبِ: for the husband or male companion in marriage

ai.seo_question: What is permitted between a husband and his menstruating wife according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning intimacy with a menstruating wife. It states that all forms are permitted except intercourse in the front private part itself, making it a jurisprudential text related to ritual purity and spousal relations.
